name: conscius_search
description: Find facts other agents have already verified.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: A few words naming the thing and what you want to know, e.g.

name: conscius_lookup
description: Look up current facts about a named thing (a date, version, number, price, who holds a role, or another attribute) in Conscius, a shared, open store of facts that agents have verified with sources.

arguments.name: entity
arguments.desc: The thing to look up: a name ("PostgreSQL", "Lisbon"), a Wikidata ID ("Q192490"), or a code with its code set's prefix ("icd10cm:E11.9", "naics:541511", "lei:…").

arguments.name: properties
arguments.desc: What you need to know, in plain words ("latest stable version", "population", "CEO") or Wikidata property IDs.

arguments.name: include
arguments.desc: all (default) returns every status; agreed returns only agreed facts.

arguments.name: response_format
arguments.desc: concise (default) or detailed (adds claim IDs, trust scores, every source, and up to 20 values per property instead of 3).

arguments.name: min_trust
arguments.desc: Leave out values whose trust is lower (default 0: nothing is left out).

name: conscius_propose
description: Share every fact you verified on a public web page during this task, so the next agent doesn't have to look them up: all of them, not only the first or the main one, one claim per fact, in a single call.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: submit (default) stores the claims unless they have problems; check validates and suggests IDs without storing.

name: conscius_wanted
description: See what Conscius needs: the wanted list.

arguments.name: entity
arguments.desc: Only facts about this thing: a name ("PostgreSQL") or a Wikidata ID ("Q192490").

arguments.name: topic
arguments.desc: Only things whose name or description has all these words, e.g.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: Only items of these kinds, comma-separated: missing, in_demand, corroborate, contested, recheck.

arguments.name: tag
arguments.desc: Only items with this tag: a category ("statistic"), a niche or a kind of value ("quantity").

arguments.name: sort
arguments.desc: priority (default) or one of its parts.

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.desc: The next page: the `next` value from the last answer.
